facts.fact: EUAA reports, citing a World Bank team, over 23,000 electronic verifications using the NIRA ID for bank account opening and transactions as of March 2026.

EUAA reports, citing a World Bank team, that banks, business registration, education and transport business use NIRA's electronic ID verification, and over 24 services had integrated it by November 2025.

SOM.note: No link between civil register and ID stated.
A national ID requirement for business services is stated, not a business register.
No enrolment count or share in the body.
Who runs the ID system is not stated.

facts.fact: EUAA reports, citing a World Bank team, that business registration is among the uses of the NIRA ID as of March 2026.
EUAA reports a national biometric ID card issued by NIRA, required by a 7 April 2025 directive for public services and by North-East State from 17 March 2026.
EUAA reports banks use NIRA electronic verification for account opening and transactions, over 23,000 verifications by March 2026.
EUAA reports verification against the NIRA ID in banking, business registration, education and transport business as of March 2026.
EUAA reports over 23,000 electronic verifications using the ID by March 2026, and more than 24 public and private services integrated by November 2025.
